published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Windshaper Skyborne; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 770.5 as Tauren on the same sim)

summary: The Wrath-only build, keeping Faerie Fire on the boss for the raid. The armor cut doesn't help its spells, so it only costs GCDs.
rotation: Racials, potions and runes on cooldown. Innervate has its own condition.
Faerie Fire first after the pull, and again when it has under 1.5s left
Insect Swarm when it is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when its DoT is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when a Wrath plus 1.5s would not land before the end
caveats: Costs 31.7 / 29.3 / 27.6 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s, against the same build without the duty.
Wrath VIII's base damage is ×1.085 the client's value.
Natural Power gloves are 8.1 DPS ahead of Arcane Power.
Subtlety 3 (Restoration) is taken for threat. It costs 2.8 / 2.8 / 2.9 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: druid__balance-wrath.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_wrath_ff rotation. Everything else is the base request. Windshaper Skyborne since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29); rotation unchanged. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
